name: kitchensink4web
description: Kitchen-sink browser MCP server: a cheap first read of any page, durable refs, and a shipped safety layer
long_description: A Model Context Protocol server for browser automation. get_page_view reads any page as a budgeted orientation with references Claude can act on; the safety layer ships on by default: server-level read-only mode, credential blindness, confirmation gates on form submits and payments, per-session budgets, and an audit trail. Capability packs (data extraction, screenshots, network, storage, downloads, diagnostics, workflows) are chosen below at install time and are fixed for the whole session. Launching this bundle requires uv (the uvx command) on your machine; the server itself is fetched from PyPI on first launch and uses its own bundled Chromium, never your browser or profile. Tip: in Claude Desktop's Tool permissions, set the Read-only tools group to Always Allow: those tools cannot change anything, and it stops most permission prompts.

allow_acting.title: Allow this server to click and type
allow_acting.description: Lets Claude click buttons, type into forms, and submit pages; leave it off and Claude can only read and navigate, with nothing on the page changeable. [COPY PENDING: manifest.allow_acting.danger | STRONG WARNING tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: this is the write switch and the single most consequential box on this screen. With it off, nothing KS4Web does can change a page. With it on, Claude can click, type, and submit on your behalf on any site you send it to, and a submitted form is not reversible. Tier-2 actions still stop and ask a human every time (paying, signing or accepting terms, deleting, posting publicly, passing an age gate) and no setting on this screen makes those proceed unattended. Leave it off unless you want Claude acting.

all_packs.title: Load every capability pack
all_packs.description: Turns on all seven packs below at once instead of choosing them one by one.

pack_extract.title: Data extraction
pack_extract.description: Pulls structured data off pages: tables, lists, links, and page details, with CSV and JSON export, and reads long documents page by page so one read never floods the conversation.

pack_capture.title: Screenshots and page capture
pack_capture.description: Takes screenshots (passwords masked) and saves pages as PDF or archive files.

pack_network.title: Network inspection
pack_network.description: Shows the page's network requests and responses, and lets Claude block or mock them for testing.

pack_storage.title: Cookies and logins
pack_storage.description: Works with cookies and site storage, and saves a signed-in session to a file so it can be reused next time. It saves the session, never the password. [COPY PENDING: manifest.pack_storage.danger | CAUTION tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: this pack reaches saved sign-ins. It can write a signed-in session to a file on this machine and load one back, which means a file that grants access to your account exists on disk until you delete it. It stores the session, never the password, and loading one stops to ask first.

pack_files.title: Downloads and uploads
pack_files.description: Downloads files from pages into one dedicated folder, fetches a file by URL through the same checks, uploads files into page forms, and reads or writes the clipboard, with every write stopping to ask first. [COPY PENDING: manifest.pack_files.danger | CAUTION tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: this pack reaches your filesystem and your clipboard. Downloads land in one dedicated folder and nowhere else, uploads send a file you name into a page's form, and a clipboard write stops to ask first. What leaves this machine is whatever you upload.

pack_diagnostics.title: Page diagnostics
pack_diagnostics.description: Reads the page's own error messages and console output, and can run a page script only after you confirm it. [COPY PENDING: manifest.pack_diagnostics.danger | STRONG WARNING tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: this pack carries evaluate_script, which runs arbitrary JavaScript inside the page with that page's full privileges, including its logged-in session. Every script is shown and confirmed before it runs, one confirmation per script, and none runs unattended. The rest of the pack only reads the page's own errors and console output.

pack_workflows.title: Recorded workflows
pack_workflows.description: Records a multi-step flow once and replays it later, checking every step still matches the page before anything runs.

pack_accessibility.title: Accessibility audit
pack_accessibility.description: Checks a page against the WCAG accessibility rules using axe-core, groups what it finds by rule, and says plainly what automated testing cannot check.

consent_scope.title: What Claude may do without asking
consent_scope.description: Type research or full. Only applies when "Allow this server to click and type" is on; leave it as research if you are unsure. [COPY PENDING: manifest.consent_scope | CAUTION tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: this sets how often Claude stops to ask you. research, the default, pre-approves reading, navigating, clicking, typing, and search-shaped form submission, and asks before anything else. full also pre-approves ordinary form submission. Neither one touches the actions that always stop and ask a human: paying, submitting a credential, sending something that reaches other people, deleting, accepting terms, and passing an age gate. It does nothing at all while acting is off, because there is nothing to consent to. This is a typed field and a value that is not one of the two words stops the server from starting, with the two words named.

preauth.title: Pre-authorized actions (advanced, leave empty)
preauth.description: Optional. Pre-approves one class of action on one site, so Claude stops asking about it. Format: class@site, for example storage_load@github.com. [COPY PENDING: manifest.preauth | CAUTION tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: empty is the normal setting and means every gate asks. One entry pre-approves ONE action class on ONE site named here, for this install, until you change it; separate several with commas and add :8h to give one a time limit. Paying, submitting a credential, sending something that reaches other people, deleting, accepting terms, acting off an allowlist, and resetting budgets can NEVER be pre-authorized, and naming one of them here stops the server from starting rather than quietly ignoring it. Like the box above, this is a typed field: a misspelling stops the server from starting and says what the format is.
